name: queue-grid formation demand envelope
description: An explicitly uncalibrated structural sweep over declared demand levels for the queue-grid formation stress case.

factors.subject: passengers
factors.rationale: These discrete alternatives expose how the deterministic grid-formation and local-motion rules respond as the authored demand approaches the 152-agent structural baseline. They are not samples from demand data or estimates of a facility population.

claim_boundary: This study reports deterministic responses to explicitly authored agent counts in an uncalibrated reference scenario. It does not establish a facility capacity, a crowd-density threshold, safety margin, demand forecast, or predictive crowd-flow result.
